content.short: Spinamp lets you listen to web3 music on mobile and web.
content.description: There's a growing library of Web3 music scattered across platforms and protocols, reflecting ongoing collaborations and fresh releases from artists pushing creative boundaries. Spinamp unites this dispersed collection into a single, seamless listening experience, making it easy to discover the artists behind the music and to explore the diverse tracks they offer across the Web3 ecosystem. By aggregating content from across networks, Spinamp provides a cohesive hub for discovery, listening, and appreciation of the evolving Web3 music scene.
